component.name: Button
component.description: Button component with polymorphic `as` support and loading state.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Interactive button element, or the polymorphic element provided through `as`.

slots.name: loading
slots.description: Loading icon shown while the button is busy.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Icon region before the button label.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Button content region after render-prop resolution.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Icon region after the button label.

own.name: as
own.description: Element or component to render as.

own.name: children
own.description: Children of the button. Supports render function form.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: leading
own.description: Leading visual content, usually an icon.

own.name: loadingAuto
own.description: Auto toggles loading while async click handlers are pending.

own.name: loadingIcon
own.description: Optional icon shown when `loading` is active.

own.name: trailing
own.description: Trailing visual content, usually an icon.

aria.name: aria-busy
aria.description: Accessibility attribute forwarded by the rendered component.

aria.name: aria-disabled
aria.description: Indicates that the control is disabled.

aria.name: aria-hidden
aria.description: Hides decorative content from assistive technology.

aria.name: aria-label
aria.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.

aria.name: role
aria.description: Defines the semantic role exposed to assistive technology.

data.name: data-disabled
data.description: Present when the component or item is disabled.

data.name: data-loading
data.description: Present when the component is loading.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.

ariaAttributes.name: aria-hidden
ariaAttributes.description: Hides decorative content from assistive technology.
